page.notes: The first word "Arthritidis" begins with a large initial A, joined to the rest of the word. "efficies" is printed with an accent over the final s-like letter, read here as efficies. "semel" is printed with a macron, read as semel[?]. "octauo" is printed with a ligature that could be read differently, kept as octauo. "eius" is printed with a long-s-like form, read as eius. No marginal notes on this page.
